newsitem.title: UK: BFI rises 19 points to 1,095 as Panamaxes firm.
newsitem.headline: BFI rises 19 points to 1,095 as Panamaxes firm.

text.p: The spot Baltic Freight Index (BFI) rose by 19 points to 1,095 on Wednesday in what brokers saw as a significant move.
They said Panamax routes in all areas had been marked up this morning and a notable feature had been the strength of grain chartering demand from the U.S. Gulf.
President G has been fixed by Cargill for 60,000 HSS U.S. Gulf/Malaysia for Oct/Nov at $20.50, up $2.00 from when the route was last fixed a fortnight ago.
NSAC have fixed Clymene 63,325 dwt delivery U.S. Gulf Nov 7/12 trip Tawian at $10,000 daily plus $165,000 bonus.
Transfield are reported to have fixed Sumava 70,456 dwt delivery U.S. Gulf end-Oct trip China at $10,900 daily plus $190,000 bonus, they said.
